messages:
Anna C: Idea — run a 2-week pilot: give 250 free credits to new API signups, but split test onboarding flows + a 20-min "Intro to Redwood" webinar for high-activity signups. Target: increase 7-day DAU and conversion to paid.

Raj P: love it. What's the hypothesis and success metric? :thinking_face: 

Anna C: Hypothesis: structured prompts + starter app templates reduce time-to-first-meaningful-call from 3 days -> 1 day. Success: 20% lift in 7-day active users and 5% higher billing conversion in 30 days.

Maria G: can we route webinar invites only to signups that hit >5 API calls in first 48h? That keeps the event high-signal.

Sam L: Yes — we can tag those leads as "engaged_trial" in Intercom and queue them to webinar flow. I'll add a filter in Zapier and send to HubSpot.

Jessie (growth-bot): Deploy checklist created: https://go.redwood.ai/docs/experiments/credit-pilot

Raj P: What about prompt templates? We should ship 6 vertical templates (search, summarization, assistant, codegen, finetune prompt engineering, reranking) inside the onboarding repo.

Anna C: Agreed. Maria — can you own templates + 1-pager usage guide? Sam — can you own routing & tagging logic?

Maria G: On it. Deliverables: template snippets, 1-pager, example cURL & JS snippets. ETA EOD Wed.

Sam L: I'll add the Intercom tag + Zapier route. Also adding a fallback email for those who miss the webinar.

Jessie (growth-bot): Quick note: we should limit credit grants to accounts with verified billing to avoid abuse. Flag: trial-credit-limit = 250

Anna C: Good call. Also let's A/B two email cadences: A = immediate webinar invite + 3 nudges; B = nudge only + product primer emails. Want to see which drives engagement without diluting active users.

Raj P: We'll need a short benchmark narrative for PR / benchmarks deck: "Starter credits + templates cut time-to-value by X; webinar increases retention for high-touch leads." I'll draft and share.

Sam L: Anyone want to present the webinar? I can host an ops walkthrough, but we should get an engineer to do a live demo. @Raj P you okay to demo model routing?

Maria G: I can do a short demo on prompt templates.

Anna C: Great. Next steps: Maria -> templates + 1-pager (EOD Wed). Sam -> routing & tags (tomorrow). Raj -> benchmark narrative draft (Fri). I'll set up calendar & landing page. :rocket:

Jessie (growth-bot): Experiment created in Growth Dashboard: EXP-2026-17-CREDIT-WAVE

Sam L: Ping me when landing page is up so I can wire tracking events. Thanks everyone :pray:
